hook: Only broke people ignore this fee
voiceover: Only broke people ignore this one line. The fund fee. One percent sounds tiny. Watch what it does. Take one hundred thousand dollars and leave it for thirty years. At an assumed seven percent, it grows to about seven hundred sixty-one thousand. Now take one percent off every year. You end near five hundred seventy-four thousand. That fee cost about one hundred eighty-seven thousand dollars. Old money reads the fine print. Find the expense ratio before you buy anything. Comment WEALTH for the free calculator.
